$comment: POST /channels/{channel.id}/messages from Discord's v10 Message resource. JSON is correct for a text-only message; files would require multipart/form-data and are deliberately outside this first action.
title: Discord message
description: Send a text message to a Discord channel.
$idempotencyComment: Discord's nonce is not merely echoed for correlation when enforce_nonce is true: for the same author and nonce within the past few minutes, Discord returns the earlier message and creates no duplicate. The 25-character maximum is enforced by every generated runtime. After Discord's short window expires, the same nonce can create another message, so hosts must not treat it as durable uniqueness.

request.$constantsComment: enforce_nonce turns nonce from a correlation value into Discord's documented short-window deduplication key. Empty allowed_mentions.parse prevents user-authored content such as @everyone or role syntax from unexpectedly notifying people; Discord specifically recommends controlling mentions for user-generated strings.

config.label: Channel ID
config.description: The Discord snowflake for a guild text channel or DM channel. The bot must be present and have Send Messages permission there.

config.label: Message
config.description: Plain message content, up to Discord's 2,000-character limit. Mentions are rendered as text but do not notify because this action sends an empty allowed_mentions parse list.

send.error: content must be at most 2000 characters

config.$maxComment: Discord caps content at 2000 characters. That cannot be DECLARED here: fancy-flow puts max on a NumberConfigField only, and putting it on a textarea stops the generated ui package compiling. Recorded rather than dropped, because the limit is real and the next author will look for it.

outputShape.description: The channel snowflake where Discord stored the message.
The bot user that authored the message.
The content Discord stored after stripping any invalid characters.
The creation time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
The supplied idempotency nonce, echoed on the message.
Attachment objects; empty for this text-only action.
Embed objects Discord derived or stored.

$outputComment: Create Message returns a Message object directly at the top level. Snowflakes are JSON strings even though they contain decimal digits, and nullable edited_timestamp is distinct from an omitted optional field.
